design_rule: Extend typed readout semantics using existing ClayCode G9 machinery; add no surface syntax unless real compilation proves a semantic gap.
fresh_alignment: Concurrent ClayCode control/effect closure independently reinforced semantic/dependency lineage continuation while runtime effect authority must be freshly validated; R8 therefore carries identity lineage but never effect authority through recurrence.

add_or_refine_fields.trace_root_hash: execution-attempt/retry trace identity bound to version
add_or_refine_fields.step_norm_current: norm of current semantic-state transition under declared projection
add_or_refine_fields.step_norm_previous: norm of previous comparable semantic-state transition
add_or_refine_fields.second_order_step_delta: difference/change in consecutive step magnitudes or typed vector second difference when available
add_or_refine_fields.step_direction_relation: cosine/orthogonality/sign relation between consecutive typed transition vectors when representation permits
add_or_refine_fields.trajectory_window_ref: bounded provenance-bound recent trajectory window used by estimator

state_capacity_profile.scratchpad_capacity: model/system working-state capacity exposed to this episode if measurable
state_capacity_profile.receiver_memory_capacity: receiver-local usable memory/state budget if measurable

add_or_refine_fields.basis_identity: episode/state/topology/dependency/capacity basis required for comparable trajectory features

derived_candidate_laws: required_recurrence_depth is conditional on available state capacity until falsified
base_compile_obligation: Represent and compile this contract with existing G9 records/types/rules through the real parser -> canonical typed IR -> type/effect -> evaluator/lowering chain; reject syntax expansion unless an executable counterexample remains.
h1_obligation: Compare scalar-delta, R7 dual-gate and R8 trajectory-capacity policies under matched compute and frozen outputs; include truthful/shuffled/no re-entry and receiver lesion/rescue controls.
